mutants.test: test/architecture/taipei_display_guard_test.dart wall-clock accessors of hawkr_api do not compile in an app
mutants.why: hawkr_api exposes `.taipei` to apps again, so an app can hand-assemble a Taipei wall-clock string and the probe compiles.

mutants.old: String? get labelIfNeeded => isTaipeiOffset(_offset) ? null : label;
mutants.why: The offset judgement is removed from the shared TaipeiDisplay, so a +8 device still gets the helper label.

mutants.test: test/shared/time/taipei_display_test.dart device offset not +8: every Taipei time carries the label
mutants.why: The shared TaipeiDisplay stops appending the label, so non +8 devices see an unlabeled Taipei time.

mutants.why: Digit-only strings go back to DateTime.tryParse, so a 10-digit seconds string is no longer read as epoch.

mutants.why: An empty startAt counts as unparsed again, so the period loses the Taipei label.
